From 1b9448b071caa7d10bb2569fabe3020a2c25ae59 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Jani Nikula <jani.nikula@intel.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2015 11:49:59 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] drm/i915: quirk backlight present on Macbook 4, 1

Unsurprisingly macbooks have backlights, just the VBT doesn't seem to
know it in this case.

Reported-and-tested-by: Daniel Nicoletti <dantti12@gmail.com>
Bugzilla: https://bugs.freedesktop.org/show_bug.cgi?id=88325
Fixes: c675949ec58c ("drm/i915: do not setup backlight if not available according to VBT")
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org # v3.15+
Reviewed-by: Ander Conselvan de Oliveira <conselvan2@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Jani Nikula <jani.nikula@intel.com>
Link: http://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/1446716999-1796-1-git-send-email-jani.nikula@intel.com

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/intel_display.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/intel_display.c
index b0f23692346e..bcf227356f78 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/intel_display.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/intel_display.c
@@ -14707,6 +14707,9 @@ static struct intel_quirk intel_quirks[] = {
 	/* Apple Macbook 2,1 (Core 2 T7400) */
 	{ 0x27a2, 0x8086, 0x7270, quirk_backlight_present },
 
+	/* Apple Macbook 4,1 */
+	{ 0x2a02, 0x106b, 0x00a1, quirk_backlight_present },
+
 	/* Toshiba CB35 Chromebook (Celeron 2955U) */
 	{ 0x0a06, 0x1179, 0x0a88, quirk_backlight_present },
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/gpu/drm/i915/intel_display.c`**
   - A new entry has been added to the `intel_quirks` array for the Apple Macbook 4,1 model. The entry specifies that the backlight is present for this model, using the `quirk_backlight_present` function.
   - The specific entry added is:
     ```c
     { 0x2a02, 0x106b, 0x00a1, quirk_backlight_present },
     ```

### Relationships

- The modification addresses a bug related to the detection of backlights on certain Macbook models, specifically the Macbook 4,1. The patch adds a quirk to ensure that the backlight is recognized as present, which was not correctly identified by the VBT (Video BIOS Table) in this case.
- This change is related to a previous fix (c675949ec58c) that prevented backlight setup if it was not available according to the VBT. The new quirk allows the backlight to be set up for the Macbook 4,1, thus correcting the oversight in the earlier implementation.

drm/i915: quirk backlight present on Macbook 4, 1

Here is the root cause:
The root cause of the bug is that the Video BIOS Table (VBT) did not correctly identify the presence of the backlight for the Apple Macbook 4,1 model. As a result, the system did not set up the backlight, leading to issues with display brightness control on this specific model.

The VBT did not correctly identify the presence of the backlight for the Apple Macbook 4,1 model, which resulted in the system not setting up the backlight. This specific entry in the code was missing the necessary quirk for the Macbook 4,1, leading to the display brightness control issues.

Reason:
This new entry adds the correct quirk for the Apple Macbook 4,1 model, allowing the system to recognize and set up the backlight properly, thus resolving the display brightness control issues that were previously encountered.
